Name: SHIE'S PORTRAITS - Younger Elliott Edit
Author: noxpallida
Description:
[center][size=4]ORIGINAL MOD: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4264]SHIE'S PORTRAITS[/url][/size][/center]
All credit for the artwork goes to Shielia, who gave me permission to share these small edits I made to Elliott's portrait. (Just in case anyone else wanted a younger looking Elliott.)

This version can be used for both the original Portraiture version of the mod, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4264][size=2]SHIE'S PORTRAITS[/size][/url], or for the Content Patcher version of the mod, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8361]Shie's Portraits for Content Patcher[/url]. I am only providing the image files here, so you [b]need[/b] to download one of them to be able to load them in correctly.

[size=3][b]Installation Instructions[/b][/size]
﻿1. Download and install either [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4264][size=2]SHIE'S PORTRAITS[/size][/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8361]Shie's Portraits for Content Patcher[/url]﻿.
﻿Requirements for [size=2][b]SHIE'S PORTRAITS[/b][/size]:
﻿ ﻿- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PyTK - Platonymous Toolkit
﻿ ﻿[/url]- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture
﻿[/url]Requirements for [b]Shie's Portraits for Content Patcher[/b]﻿:
﻿ ﻿- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PyTK - Platonymous Toolkit[/url]
﻿ ﻿- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
2. Download this mod and extract the .zip file contents.
3. Move the files "Elliott.png" and "Elliott_IslandSouth.png" to...
[b]SHIE'S PORTRAITS[/b]: ﻿"Mods\Portraiture\Portraits\SHIE'SPORTRAITS"
﻿[b]Shie's Portraits for Content Patcher[/b]﻿: "Mods\[CP] Shie's Portraits\assets"
4. Overwrite the files when prompted.
